sgwt
====

Spectral Graph Wavelet Transforms and tools for Graph Signal Processing.

``sgwt`` provides numerical tools for constructing spectral graph wavelets,
graph filters, and related operators based on the graph Laplacian. The package
is designed for research and experimental workflows in graph signal processing.

.. rubric:: Key Features

- Spectral graph wavelet construction
- Scale-dependent graph filtering
- Efficient Laplacian-based operators
- NumPy / SciPy compatible
